environment: Linux x64 cloud workspace, Node v24.20.0; not Windows, no DPAPI/WPF/UIA/Edge

checks.nativeWindowsCompile: NOT RUN (needs Windows PowerShell GAC assembly; known environment limit)

tests.name: Cached pre-rename resource and App tools retain scoped approval, without advertising old names
Renamed catalog, snapshots, conflict safety, approvals and continuation
First-use proof requires the exact marker result on an authenticated transport; fixture is not real ChatGPT acceptance
Real authenticated HTTP: OAuth PKCE, consent, catalog, tool call and revocation
Twelve concurrent real MCP HTTP handshakes share one ready broker
DPAPI OAuth state survives restart; refresh rotates and replay revokes its family
Owner pipe authenticates, exposes no tool execution and drains at most once per message
Actual broker preserves pending approvals during drain and records marker result; controlled transport fixture is NOT ChatGPT
Owner approval page explains a wrong key, a foreign or expired request and rate limiting without leaking the key
Branded approval bundle executes with its real browser CSP; not a ChatGPT host test
Browser fixtures handle old metadata and current metadata with the matching App tool names; not host attestation
Native Windows checks preserve read-only AST boundaries without executing submitted text
Native state ACL audit rejects a linked descendant and a drive root; never weakens private state
Actual isolated Edge, native UIA fixture and durable job output
Fixture decisions: Deny, bounded chat grant, context revocation; not human-host attestation

npmTest.interpretation: Failures are Windows preconditions (Expected absolute local drive path, Native Windows checks unavailable, DPAPI). Identical on unmodified code; used only as a comparison baseline.
